decisions.reason: As a publicly highlighted flagship product with repeated gold-medal recognition and a close fit to the firm's traditional strengths, management is very likely to continue it rather than admit a mistaken commitment.

This bread remains actively presented over two years and builds directly on the firm's established bakery capabilities, so management has enough visible commitment and no clear failure signal to justify keeping it.

The marzipan Christmas stollen stays on its own product page across both years and fits the firm's core seasonal confectionery offer, making withdrawal less likely under an escalation-of-commitment logic.
